result.instructions: ToolBelt is a Mac menu bar app whose plugins show the person's tasks, software updates, processes and more. Call toolbelt_status first, then read_screen for detail or search_screens to find something across plugins. Access is read-only: describe what the person can do in ToolBelt rather than claiming to have done it. Plugins the person or plugin author kept from agents are not listed.

tools.name: toolbelt_status
tools.title: ToolBelt status
tools.description: What ToolBelt is running: the app version and any app update, and each plugin agents can see with its state and screens. Start here.

tools.name: list_screens
tools.title: List screens
tools.description: Every plugin screen agents can read, as plugin and screen ids for read_screen.

tools.name: read_screen
tools.title: Read a screen
tools.description: Read one plugin screen as the person would see it: tables with their rows and details, lists, forms, stats and logs, with times as absolute and relative. Search, filters and open dialogs are shared with people viewing the same screen, so the result notes any that apply. Long tables are paged.

plugin.description: Plugin id, from toolbelt_status or list_screens.

screen.description: Screen id; omit for the plugin's default screen.

format.description: text (default) is compact; json is the plugin's UI tree.

details.description: Include each row's inspector details (default true).

tools.name: search_screens
tools.title: Search all screens
tools.description: Find lines mentioning every word of a query across all screens agents can read (tasks, updates, notes, settings). Returns matching lines with their plugin, screen and section; read_screen gives the full context.

query.description: Words to look for (case-insensitive, all must appear on the line).

tools.name: list_plugins
tools.title: Installed plugins
tools.description: Installed plugins agents can see: version, repository, enabled or not, and any update available.
